title: De vuelta a casa · la Meridiana de noche
description: Night and the way home (docs/chapter-2.md § Night and the way home, src/night.ts): home's door at Meridiana 335 by day, on the odd side facing the camera (VivaGym on Gerard's right as he comes out, the portal, Bluespace's ramp going down on his left); then night, the fifth day: out of the L1's Concepció Arenal stair on the even side, the palace's guards coming up out of the grates, home's side of the avenue lit by its lamps, the avenue from above at night, home's portal as the warmest light on the street, and through it the day is over. Last, the picker's way home at the castle's last stage.

steps.caption: Meridiana 335 by day, on the far side of the avenue facing the camera: VivaGym's lit window on Gerard's right as he comes out, the portal with 335 on its canopy, Bluespace's blue band and ramp going down on his left

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, at = g.world(g.position.x - 1, g.position.z - 3); g.frame({ x: at.x, y: 2, z: at.z }, 5); }

steps.caption: Up close: the gym, the door with the lobby lit behind it, the intercom, the storage ramp and the kerb lowered for it

Night, the fifth day: up the L1's Concepció Arenal stair on the even side of the avenue, under the near blocks (seen through their window); the guards climb out of the grates in a puff of the trains' draught

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, at = g.world(g.position.x - 16, g.position.z - 10); g.frame({ x: at.x, y: 1, z: at.z }, 18); }

steps.caption: Looking along the way home, across the avenue and towards Meridiana 335: the palace's guards out on the pavements and the median, walking their rounds round the grates they came up from
Over the zebra, on home's side: lamp light pools on the panot (the nearest lamps light for real), lit flats and shop windows, the dark gaps between lamps where they see less
The avenue from above at night: home on the left, the Fabra i Puig crossing on the right, Hipercor's back nearest the camera, her pink low in the haze
Home's portal at night: the warmest light on the street; they never step into it
Through the door at night: Aitor, «Ya está. Dentro.», and the day is over
The next morning, at home: the hunt is over until the next night
The picker's De noche · La vuelta a casa: the level is her castle's stage (here 4, on the Meridiana), and the line says the day it means and how hard the night is
Jumped from the picker at castle stage 4: day 6, out of Fabra i Puig, the last night's five guards out and one lamp in three dark
